state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 6 (typed values) in progress: item 1 of 3 done.** Stages 1 to 5 are done, and Stage 4 is done except for a CA that a program supplies. `nvs-config` reads `[ldap.<name>]` and `[capabilities.ldap]`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` opens connections and runs `who_am_i`, `search` and `read`.

**On `main`**: `Ldap\Connection::whoami`/`search`/`read`, `Ldap\Entries`, `Ldap\Entry`, `Ldap\Scope`, `Ldap\Settings`, `Ldap\Filter`, `Ldap\Dn`, `Ldap\Ad`, and now `Ldap\Sid` (`parse`, `toString`, `bytes`, `domain(): ?Sid`, `rid`) and `Entry`'s typed readers `uuid`, `sid`, `sids`, `instant`, `duration`. The decoders are `crates/nvs-ldap/src/value.rs`, so Rust tests reach them with no server. The Novis bodies are `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/sid.rs` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs`. `instant` picks FILETIME or GeneralizedTime by the value's form, not yet by the schema (item 3). `Entry::int` and `Entry::bool` are not written yet.

Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`, or over cleartext at `ldap://127.0.0.1:16389`. `CN=Users` holds exactly three users: `Administrator`, `Guest` and `krbtgt`. Guest and krbtgt are disabled. GUIDs, SIDs and times change each time the container is made, so a case asserts their shape (RID 500, version 4, the domain's SID), never the value. Samba's defaults are stable: `maxPwdAge` is `6w`, `lockoutDuration` is `30m`.

items.text: **`Ad\AccountFlags` and `Ad\GroupType`, readonly objects with one `bool` per flag, keeping unnamed bits, and `Entry::accountFlags`/`groupType`/`accountType`** (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`, ADR 0278 §§ 1 and 8). Classes beside `AD` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:1414`), readers beside `nvs_core_ldap_entry_duration` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:149`). Rust test `account_flags_keep_the_bits_they_do_not_name` after `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs:771`; case `tests/conformance/core/ldap-account-flags.nvst`. Guest and krbtgt are disabled, so `disabled` is a flag a case can assert.

**Ranged attribute merge and the schema read once per pool** (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`, ADR 0278 § 8). The search loop is `nvs_core_ldap_entries_advance` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:370`), and an entry is built by `entry_value` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:108`). Rust tests `a_ranged_member_list_is_merged_to_its_end` and `the_schema_is_read_once_per_pool`.
**`Entry::int` and `Entry::bool`** (ADR 0278 § 1's roster, `TRUE`/`FALSE` in § 8's table). Readers beside the others in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:149`.

backlog: A CA a program supplies for `Ldap::open` (Stage 4 remainder, ADR 0278 § 2).
Stages 7 to 10: writes and passwords, `authenticate`, the AD extras, the feature proofs (`data/goals/ldap.json` checks).
`instant` and the other typed readers choose by the value's form. Once item 2 reads the schema, a reader may check the attribute's syntax too (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`).
